description: Phase 05 fair comparison for C9 (E13): samples to estimate a PNP loss to additive error eps, quantum sampling (exact single-shot variance) versus B1 term-wise Lim-Oh with Neyman allocation versus B2 exact classical evaluation. Haar U in U(16), input |1,0,...> (n=8), PNPs from the 152 PNMs of order 1-2, |A| in {10,20,40,80,150}, 3 unitaries x 5 draws, balanced U[-1,1] and positive U[0,1] coefficients. Protocol: LOG.md Phase 5 Comparison Plan.
